cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though CAMS has an overall MAE of 19.6 against ground measurements, our live track record shows the model beats CAMS 83 of 86 days with an overall skill vs CAMS of 50.9%. CAMS provides valuable large-scale atmospheric context and transport patterns that our machine learning model corrects using local data and ground-truth error patterns.
